description: This file defines an SMTP class implementing RFC 821 SMTP protocol functions, used for sending emails via SMTP servers. It includes connection handling, authentication, and email transmission methods.

classes.name: SMTP
classes.description: A class implementing SMTP protocol functions for email communication, including connection, authentication, and message sending.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified SMTP server.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Performs SMTP authentication with username and password.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Sends email message data to the SMTP server.
